name: design-challenge-framer
description: Turns a fuzzy ask into a proper design challenge brief, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run design-challenge-framer", "frame this challenge", "write the challenge brief", "help me scope this design project", "we want to improve X, where do we start", or a new project is starting and the problem is still a feeling rather than a statement. Use it even for "the client wants an app".
